endpoint_definition: 10 subsequent full Nasdaq equity sessions, excludes Sep30 remainder, gross terminal close return; Oct12 equities open
current_query: Sep30 partial OHLC and last quote, proxy only; cannot calibrate exact intraday entry probability

ridge.scale: training-only median and IQR, standardized feature clipping +/-5

knn.selection: equal Euclidean distance in same training-only scale; signal spacing >=11 sessions

models.primary_point: equal 50/50 ridge and knn median, predefined; no weight selection by evaluation

evaluation.training_maturity: all labels end on or before completed query signal date; expanding fit

prediction_bands: equal ensemble log point plus 2023-2026 walk-forward empirical normalized residual quantiles [.1,.25,.5,.75,.9] times current rv20*sqrt10; reference bands, no certified coverage
analogue_paths: same32 neighbors; 1..10 sessions close/high/low paths volatility-rescaled to current rv20; separate raw historical counts and path-stop outcomes; no assert daily ordering

execution_context.current_remaining_day: not modeled; might trigger stop before first full future session

limitations: single named survivor ticker and regime changes
current partial-bar vs historical full-close proxy mismatch
no current option term structure or order book
scope: Same10-session models for both named stocks; latest supplementary price/volume, benchmark RS, beta, volatility, options and macro diagnostic factors kept outside historical model, no hand-adjusted odds
model_source: 研究记录/2026-09-30-AAOI十交易日走势/protocol.json
options: Delayed public Cboe; own30calendar-day ATM IV via nearest strike valid call+put average and totalvariance interpolation between expiries; label proxy, no yearly IV percentile
macro_method: 20 Nasdaq sessions prior, dates aligned with Yahoo QQQ complete session index; latest observation/availability logged; macro diagnostics not historic regression input
